claims.statement: The standalone version fragment specifies Windows Visual Studio 2022 17.8 or later for general Copilot use and links to Microsoft installation documentation. This lower general prerequisite does not supersede the 17.11 SKU-isolation requirement previously reviewed, prove compatibility in this environment, or verify current support; the external guide was not reviewed.

The JSON settings example enables editor inline suggestions, sets the default Copilot language toggle true, explicitly disables YAML and plaintext, and explicitly enables Markdown, JavaScript, and Python. An illustrative local language toggle is not all-product disablement, content exclusion, organization policy, or measured enforcement. The configuration was not installed.

The Mac note states that Copilot is unavailable for Visual Studio for Mac at the pinned revision. This is a product-specific historical limitation, not a claim about VS Code on macOS, all Mac editors, or current product availability.

The VS Code prerequisite fragment calls for the latest editor and GitHub sign-in, with download and authentication-troubleshooting links. Latest is relative to the source's release context, not a concrete version floor here; sign-in advice is not authority to change credentials or proof of authentication. Destinations were not reviewed.

The settings fragment describes File, Preferences, Settings navigation with an image caption. It specifies no configured value or successful policy change; the screenshot was not visually inspected and no editor setting was changed.

The compatibility fragment attributes Chat/editor release coupling to UI integration and says each new Chat version requires the latest VS Code. It separately claims latest Chat versions use the latest service LLM because even minor upgrades need prompt/extension changes, while older Chat still uses latest inline suggestions. These distinct historical consumer/model assertions are not a tested compatibility matrix, current model entitlement, or justification to collapse Chat and inline-suggestion version requirements.
